title: Find All Pair Sums
question: Print pairs of values whose sum equals a target.
code:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
target = int(input())
pairs = [(nums[i], nums[j]) for i in range(len(nums)) for j in range(i + 1, len(nums)) if nums[i] + nums[j] == target]
print(pairs)
explanation: Each pair is considered once using i less than j.
